english.title: Offender 18 or over conspire to cause a child under 13 to watch / look at an image of sexual activity - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person aged 18 or over, for the purpose of obtaining sexual gratification, conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to intentionally cause a child under the age of 13, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), to

(E)_[watch a third person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary section12(1)(a), (b), (c)(ii) and (2) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and section1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 72 allows the prosecution of British citizens and UK residents for this offence where committed abroad.
(ii) A person guilty of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act (paragraph 21 of Schedule 3).
(iii) See also offence wordings: H5702 - relating to a child victim aged 13/14/15.

other.penalty: Indictable: maximum 10 years imprisonment Time limit for prosecutions:None
